Frequently Asked Questions

Is PIEAS better than Aga Khan University?

Both Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences and Aga Khan University are HEC-recognized universities. PIEAS is public (est. 1997) in Islamabad, while Aga Khan University is private (est. 1983) in Karachi. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between PIEAS and Aga Khan University?

PIEAS's fee is approximately Rs. 1.3–1.6L/sem per semester, while Aga Khan University's is Rs. 8L–2.5M/year. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for PIEAS and Aga Khan University?

PIEAS: 60% PIEAS Written Test + 40% FSc/A-Level (min 60% marks). MS: written test + interview (esp. for PAEC Fellowship).. Aga Khan University: Merit + AKU Admission Test + interview. Program-specific tests for MBBS, Nursing. Criteria: academic record, critical reasoning, English fluency, interview, extracurriculars..
